zh: 我买了两盒巧克力。
en: I bought two {boxes::box} of chocolates.

zh: 他们有三个孩子。
en: They have three {children::child}.

zh: 有三家公司申请了这份合同。
en: Three {companies::company} have applied for the contract.

zh: 你能给我发一些关于这门课程的信息吗？
en: Could you send me some {information::information} about the course?

zh: 小心，这些刀很锋利。
en: Be careful, these {knives::knife} are very sharp.

zh: 每天要刷两次牙。
en: Brush your {teeth::tooth} twice a day.

zh: 这些鞋我穿太小了。
en: {These::this/these} shoes are too small for me.

zh: 请把书放回那几个书架上。
en: Please put the books back on the {shelves::shelf}.

zh: 她给了我很多好建议。
en: She gave me a lot of good {advice::advice}.

zh: 走了一整天，我的两只脚都疼。
en: My {feet::foot} hurt after walking all day.

zh: 我需要两公斤土豆。
en: I need two kilos of {potatoes::potato}.

zh: 你一天收到多少封邮件？
en: How {many::much/many} emails do you get a day?

zh: 会议室里有多少人？
en: How many {people::person} are in the meeting room?

zh: 她给我看了几张度假时拍的照片。
en: She showed me some {photos::photo} from her holiday.

zh: 我们给公寓买了一些新家具。
en: We bought some new {furniture::furniture} for the flat.

zh: 我们团队里有四位女士。
en: There are four {women::woman} on our team.

zh: 祝你新年万事如意！
en: Best {wishes::wish} for the new year!

zh: 你有多少行李？
en: How much {luggage::luggage} do you have?

zh: 我团队里的人都很乐于助人。
en: The people in my team {are::be} really helpful.

zh: 我们家车库里有好几只老鼠。
en: We have {mice::mouse} in the garage.

zh: 健身房里所有的器材都是新的。
en: All the {equipment::equipment} at the gym is new.

zh: 有两辆公交车没停就开过去了。
en: Two {buses::bus} went past without stopping.

zh: 我有个好消息要告诉你。
en: I have some good {news::news} for you.

zh: 这条信息已经过时了。
en: {This::this/these} information is out of date.

zh: 这条裤子太长了。
en: These {trousers::trouser} are too long.

zh: 秋天树叶会变红。
en: The {leaves::leaf} turn red in autumn.

zh: 谢谢你对我的演讲提的所有意见。
en: Thanks for all your {feedback::feedback} on my speech.

zh: 离登机没多少时间了。
en: We don't have {much::much/many} time before the flight.

zh: 能把剪刀递给我吗？
en: Can you pass me the {scissors::scissor}, please?

zh: 我一周工作四天。
en: I work four {days::day} a week.

zh: 我们所有的员工都很友好。
en: All our {staff::staff} are friendly.

zh: 消防员每天都在拯救生命。
en: Firefighters save {lives::life} every day.

zh: 这套家具放在这个房间里太大了。
en: This furniture {is::be} too big for the room.

zh: 新西兰的羊比人还多。
en: There are more {sheep::sheep} than people in New Zealand.

zh: 请给我们两杯水，好吗？
en: Could we have two {glasses::glass} of water, please?

zh: 孩子们今晚有很多作业。
en: The kids have a lot of {homework::homework} tonight.

zh: 把牛油果切成两半。
en: Cut the avocado into two {halves::half}.

zh: 我们用三条标准来挑选供应商。
en: We use three {criteria::criterion} to choose a supplier.

zh: 这两份分析得出了不同的结论。
en: The two {analyses::analysis} reached different conclusions.

zh: 这家公司挺过了两次危机。
en: The company has survived two {crises::crisis}.
